svg.aria-label: The project lifecycle and the skills that serve it. Set up: download, unzip, rename, then the first check-in. The repeatable middle: check-in, ongoing, triage and save, repeated for as long as the project runs. Close out: the project closeout. Alongside, the skills used as the work needs them: ingest and online research, deliverable brief and draft document, handoff, and system settings.
